messages:
anita: Heads-up — I'm scheduling a safety cordon for kernel build 5.3.2q tonight. Target window: 02:00 PT. Plan is a build-matrix sanity pass (cross-ABI, matmul kernels, KV cache warmup) before we consider wider rollout.

marc: ack. i'll take cross-ABI smoke on eu-west-1 machines (a100, h100 mix). ETA ~02:10 PT.

kai: i'll run the microbench perf probes and sanity workloads (latency tail + memory under load). I'll also validate the new fused matmul path vs baseline.

ryan: oncall watching. i'll wire up a temporary alert group for the run: p95 latency > 420ms OR error-rate delta > 3% => page.

olivia: putting a short release-notes blurb in drafts: "kernel 5.3.2q: fused matmul fixes, improved kv-cache eviction heuristics, quantized path stabilization". adding explicit rollback triggers.

anita: deploy-bot, schedule the night-bucket cordon + preflight:
```
/deploy schedule --tag kernel-5.3.2q --buckets night --cordon safety --preflight build-matrix --timeout 45m
```

deploy-bot: scheduled by anita at 2167894321. preflight jobs queued: build-matrix, kv-warm, matmul-smoke. Expected completion by 2167894500.

marc: quick note — i saw one config drift in the staging h100 images yesterday (libc mismatch). i'll validate the image hashes before smoke.

kai: running the perf probe now. will post summaries.

kai: perf probe results: fused-matmul latency median +3% but p95 flat. memory use within expected. no crashes. attaching snippet:
```
probe: fused_matmul / latency_ms: { median: 2.1, p95: 9.4 }
probe: baseline_matmul / latency_ms: { median: 2.0, p95: 9.3 }
```

marc: cross-ABI smoke green on eu-west-1. no ABI symbol errors. KV-warm shows expected hit-rate improvement.

olivia: release notes updated with rollback criteria: "rollback if error-rate increases >3% for 15m OR p95 increases >30% baseline for 15m OR a crash loop observed on >1% of hosts."

ryan: telemetry check running — hooking in a short-lived destiny alert: `destiny:kernel-canary-telemetry` with thresholds per olivia.

anita: if everything stays green by 02:45 PT, we lift cordon to morning window (06:00 PT) for a broader progressive rollout. if any red flags we pin traffic back to kernel-5.3.1 and abort.

marc: noted. i'll keep an eye until 03:00 PT and will call for immediate pin if i see ABI mismatches.

deploy-bot: preflight completed at 2167894458. results: build-matrix=PASS, kv-warm=PASS, matmul-smoke=PASS.

anita: nice. thanks team. final ask: please paste any small anomalies here (logs, diffs). i'll open the rollout ticket and include a brief in #eng-releases.

kai: one tiny UDP spike on a single host, investigating. likely infra noise, posting logs shortly.

olivia: drafted rollout notes and changelog entry; added owner links and rollback steps.

anita: ok — promoting to morning-window candidate. if no pages by 03:15 PT i'll flip the schedule. thanks all :raised_hands:
